page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top left; no marginal notes; numbered theses in italic, then roman paragraph below.

main_text.l: 6. Accidentia sunt accidentia etiamsi nulli accidant.
7. Sacratissimum corpus Christi à moribus editur.
11. Per benedictionem divinam res creata destruitur.
12. Datur axioma non identicum, licet praedicatum idem sit cum subjecto.
13. Axioma verum esse potest, etiam cum praedicatum falsò enuntiatur de subjecto.
main_text.p: Item illa quae leguntur in missali Romano, de defectibus circa missam occurrentibus, cap. 10.
14. Si sacerdos evomat eucharistiam, si species integrae appareant, reverenter sumantur.

page.notes: Theses 6–14 are numbered lines in italic and are transcribed as list lines; the printed numbers are kept as they appear. Some long-s and ligature forms were normalised to plain letters.
